label: sec:crystal-resonance-data
html:
Existing data sets.

  • Many-body interference measurements in kagome crystals [guo2025], which probe coherent lattice-scale quantum effects.
  • Chiral phonon spectroscopy in rare-earth halide crystals [luo2023], documenting orientation-dependent effective magnetic fields from lattice vibrations.
  • Non-monotonic magnetic friction measurements in commensurate rotor-substrate arrays [gu2026], exhibiting collective magnetically driven dissipation absent physical contact.
  • High-Q quartz bulk acoustic wave (BAW) oscillator noise measurements, which log excess phase noise beyond established thermal limits.
  • Precision Casimir-effect experiments utilizing crystalline surfaces (such as silicon and gold single crystals).
  • Resonant-mass gravitational wave detector data (from AURIGA and NAUTILUS bar detectors), which logged orientation-dependent noise floors in cryogenic crystalline bars.
